meta.title: Fines for Smoking in No-Smoking Zones in Korea
meta.description: How much is the fine for smoking in a no-smoking zone in Korea? Fines by type of place under Article 34 of the National Health Promotion Act and Annex 5 of its Enforcement Decree (100,000 won for public-use facilities, 50,000 won for apartment complexes), whether e-cigarettes are covered, and fines for facility managers.

fine.title: Fines for Smoking in No-Smoking Zones in Korea
fine.subtitle: National Health Promotion Act, Article 34 · Enforcement Decree, Annex 5
fine.answer: Under subparagraph 2 of Article 34 (3) of the National Health Promotion Act, smoking in a no-smoking zone is subject to a fine of up to 100,000 won. Under the imposition standards in Annex 5 of the Enforcement Decree, the fine is 100,000 won for public-use facilities and for zones within 30 meters of kindergartens, daycare centers, and elementary, middle, and high schools, and 50,000 won for no-smoking zones in apartment complexes.

meta.title: Designating No-Smoking Zones in Korean Apartment Complexes
meta.description: How can hallways, stairways, elevators, and underground parking lots in a Korean apartment complex become no-smoking zones? The application by at least half of households under Article 9 (5) of the National Health Promotion Act, the consent rules in Article 6-2 of the Enforcement Rule, and the 50,000 won fine.

apartment.title: Designating No-Smoking Zones in Korean Apartment Complexes
apartment.subtitle: National Health Promotion Act, Article 9 (5)
apartment.answer: If at least half of the households in an apartment complex apply, all or part of its hallways, stairways, elevators, and underground parking lots can be designated as no-smoking zones (Article 9 (5) of the National Health Promotion Act). Smoking in a designated apartment no-smoking zone is subject to a fine of 50,000 won (Annex 5 of the Enforcement Decree).
